en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Amro Bin Usman, from Al Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Jabir Bin Yazeed, 
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘

The first of what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Judge on the Day of Judgement would be regarding the blood-shed. So He<sup>azwj</sup> would Pause the two sons of Adam<sup>as</sup>, so He<sup>azwj</sup> would Decide between the two of them. Then it would be those from the committers of the blood-shed who stained themselves by what they (the sons of Adam<sup>as</sup>) did, until there does not remain anyone from them. Then it would be the (other) people after that, to the extent that the murdered one would come with his murderer, so his face would be soaked in his blood, so he would be saying, ‘This one killed me’. So He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Saying: “Did you kill him?’ So he would not be able to conceal any statement from Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
